analytical_dimensions.description: Claims and immediate origins Assign an intermediary citation separately to each claim's full predicate. Inspect the sentence boundary and the exact position of the citation: a citation closing one sentence does not automatically cover the next sentence, especially one beginning Meanwhile or introducing a different actor, amount or program. When the source states a claim without an attached citation, record author assertion / upstream unspecified; a neighboring reference can only be an explicitly unresolved candidate. Keep these distinct in every table cell and summary; never merge a cited award and an uncited loan into one attributed financial claim. Do not upgrade bibliography metadata into evidence of what an unseen source actually says.
probing_questions: Where do these claims come from, and how reliable are those sources?
